top_liked.author: @JustAnotherHodie
top_liked.text:
Your fear originates inside of you. It is a part of you. It has a purpose. 
Talk to it, discover it's purpose, give it a name. Then, befriend it.
Fear is a powerful force, especially when it's on your side and you don't fear it.
